settings.input_mode: First Frame + Last Frame + text prompt

global_rules: Preserve the exact geometry and layout of the uploaded frames.
Interpolate only between visible elements already present in the uploaded frames.
Do not introduce alternate branding, new UI elements, or new symbols.
Each panel's internal content may refine only within its own boundary — no cross-panel content migration.
general_tips: Do NOT describe what is IN the frames — only camera path, transformation, and ambient sound mood
Do NOT mention specific UI text, numbers, or labels — the frames carry that
Do NOT mention buttons you do NOT want pressed (Pink Elephant problem)
One primary camera movement per prompt — keep it simple
Start simple, regenerate with more detail if first attempt is too generic

logo_shots_V01_V10.asset_lock: If Google Flow supports 'Ingredients to Video', upload the clean Poseidon trident logo as a locked persistent asset for V01 and V10.
logo_shots_V01_V10.compositing_fallback: If logo still hallucinates after 2-3 attempts: render clean background motion only, composite the exact logo as PNG/SVG overlay in post (Premiere / After Effects / CapCut).

segments.name: Void to Trident
segments.prompt: Slow cinematic push-in from complete darkness toward a single glowing cyan light point at center frame. The camera starts static for half a second, then accelerates gently forward. Shallow depth of field at f/1.4 creates soft bokeh. As the light expands, three curved organic lines emerge outward from the center — sweeping, fluid arcs like calligraphy strokes, NOT straight geometric prongs. The lines have no handle or stem below them. Studio lighting reveals glass-like reflective surfaces with cyan-to-blue specular highlights. The camera settles on an extreme close-up of the final composition. Deep sub-bass tone rises gradually from silence. Dark mode studio environment with polished reflective floor. CRITICAL: No classical trident shape, no straight prongs, no handle, no shaft, no arrow tips at any intermediate frame.
qc: No classical trident shape at any intermediate frame — prongs must be curved and organic
No handle, shaft, or stem artifact below the logo at any point
No straight prongs or arrow-tip shapes
Final frame matches F02 exactly

segments.name: Trident Macro to Chaos
segments.prompt: Rapid camera retreat from the extreme macro. As the camera accelerates backward, horizontal anamorphic lens streaks stretch across the frame from the glass surfaces — elongated cyan light trails spanning edge to edge. The camera sweeps upward in a 45-degree arc while the anamorphic streaks gradually shorten and dissolve. Motion blur intensifies during peak acceleration then softens as the camera decelerates. The camera settles at a 45-degree isometric overhead view. Cinematic shallow depth of field throughout. Dark studio void with no physical surfaces. Sound: rushing digital wind with a harmonic pitch-rise, then dissonant notification tones as the view widens.
qc: Prompt contains ZERO content descriptions — only camera path, anamorphic streaks, DOF, and sound
All content carried entirely by First Frame (F02) and Last Frame (F03) images
Anamorphic streaks bridge F02 macro to F03 wide shot structurally
No physical floor or ground surface
45-degree isometric final angle

segments.name: Chaos to Cost Cards
segments.prompt: Camera begins a slow push-in from the isometric overhead view. Simultaneously, ambient light dims progressively from the edges of the frame inward — a gradual luminance collapse. The outermost elements darken first into silhouettes, then the inner elements follow. Color desaturates toward monochrome as energy drains from the scene. Only a warm concentrated glow persists at the center of the frame. The camera continues forward through the dimming space toward the central light source. Depth of field narrows to f/1.4 with the center composition emerging in sharp warm focus against surrounding darkness. Dark studio environment. Sound: descending filtered tones, each frequency cutting out one by one, final deep resonant pulse.
qc: Prompt contains ZERO content descriptions — only camera, luminance, DOF, and sound
All card content carried entirely by First Frame (F03) and Last Frame (F04) images
Light drains edge-to-center: outermost elements darken first, innermost last
Center in sharp warm focus, edges in darkness
No banned words used

segments.name: Cost Cards to Thesis
segments.prompt: Slow elegant push-in toward the center glass card. The camera targets the middle element directly. As the camera advances, progressive gaussian blur spreads across the entire frame — edges soften first, then the full composition dissolves into an abstract luminous field. The camera continues forward through the blurred field into a clean dark void. The text "Data aggregation is solved." fades in at center frame in crisp white. The camera holds static. Then the text "Coordination is not." appears below it — this second line ignites with a vivid cyan-to-magenta gradient glow that pulses once and settles into a luminous steady radiance. A soft cyan rim light along the frame border intensifies in sync with the second line. The camera remains perfectly centered and static. Sound: glass resonance fading to silence, crisp mechanical click on the first line, deep sub-bass pulse with a bright crystalline shimmer on the second line.
qc: Camera targets CENTER card directly — NOT the gap between cards
Progressive full-frame blur bridges F04 cards to dark void
First line: white, clean fade-in — no color effect
Second line: cyan-to-magenta gradient glow, pulses once then settles — vivid but not a flash
Text matches F05 Last Frame exactly: Line 1 = Data aggregation is solved. Line 2 = Coordination is not.
Cyan rim light intensifies in sync with second line appearance

segments.name: Thesis to Dashboard Transformation
segments.prompt: Camera holds static on the centered composition for one beat. Then the camera slowly pushes in — the frame compresses inward, edges darkening as the view narrows to an extreme close-up. The compression holds for one beat of complete silence. Then the camera smoothly reverses into a pull-back, expanding outward in a sweeping 45-degree arc upward. During the entire pull-back, heavy gaussian blur covers the full frame — all emerging elements remain completely unreadable soft shapes. The blur persists throughout the expansion. Only in the final half-second does the blur rapidly clear, snapping the isometric overhead composition into sharp focus. Polished reflective floor visible. Dark studio throughout — no added brightness. Sound: compressed silence during the push-in, a single deep sub-bass release on the pull-back, then a quiet sustained warm chord as focus snaps sharp.
qc: Prompt contains ZERO content descriptions — no dashboard layout, no KPI values, no panel names
All dashboard content carried entirely by Last Frame (F06)
CRITICAL: heavy full-frame blur persists during entire pull-back phase — content never readable until final snap
Blur clears only in the final half-second — prevents Veo from rendering intermediate content
Exhale pattern: push-in compression → hold → blurred pull-back expansion → sharp snap
No light trails, no bloom — dark throughout

segments.name: Dashboard to Engine Close-Up
segments.prompt: Smooth cinematic tracking shot. Camera glides forward and slightly downward, transitioning from 45-degree to 30-degree angle, pushing toward the lower four-panel grid. The top row of smaller cards drifts upward and out of frame. Depth of field gradually shallows — background dissolves into colored bokeh. The camera settles at a 30-degree close-up of four equal glass panels in a 2×2 grid. All panel content is frozen and identical to the start and end frames throughout the entire motion. PROTECT (green edge) keeps its threat list. GROW (violet edge) keeps its smooth clean line graph with no added arrows or dots. EXECUTE (amber edge) keeps its exact same three horizontal bars and text. GOVERN (blue edge) keeps 97/100 with compliance badges. Only the camera angle changes — panel interiors are static. Sound: sustained warm synth chord with four distinct tonal pings.
qc: All panel content is frozen throughout — only camera angle changes
GROW line graph has no added arrows, dots, markers, or shape changes — smooth clean line only
EXECUTE bars remain at exact same fill levels — no bar length changes or text changes
KPI row cards exit cleanly upward
Final layout matches F07
Panel sizes remain equal throughout — no panel grows or shrinks relative to others

segments.name: Engine Grid to PROTECT Zoom
segments.last_frame: F07 zoomed into PROTECT panel (use a cropped version of F07 showing only the top-left green-bordered panel filling the frame)
segments.compositing_instruction: Veo cannot interpolate between F07 and F08 (structurally different layouts). Instead: (1) Use F07 as First Frame and a zoomed crop of F07's PROTECT panel as Last Frame — this gives Veo a pure camera zoom on identical content. (2) In post-production (Premiere / After Effects / CapCut), trim V07 to end just as the PROTECT panel fills the frame, then add a 0.3–0.5s dissolve transition to F08 (static). (3) Overlay a cursor-click animation on F08 in post — white cursor taps the red Block & Dispute button with a circular glow ripple.
segments.prompt: Slow cinematic push-in toward the top-left panel. Camera starts at a 30-degree isometric overview, then gradually narrows focus on the green-bordered region. Depth of field shallows progressively — the three surrounding panels soften into colored bokeh. The green-bordered area fills the entire frame. Lighting shifts from balanced four-color to dominant green accent rim glow. Dark studio background throughout. Sound: sustained warm tone narrowing to a single green frequency, then silence.
qc: First Frame and Last Frame are BOTH derived from F07 — same content, different zoom level
Veo only interpolates a camera zoom — zero layout changes, zero content changes
F08 appearance and cursor click are added in post-production via compositing
Dark background throughout

segments.name: PROTECT to GROW Recommendation
segments.prompt: Smooth controlled pull-back from the current macro view. The camera reverses and executes a lateral arc tracking rightward, tracing a gentle S-curve through space. Depth of field stays shallow throughout — everything outside the camera's focal point remains in soft bokeh. Accent rim lighting transitions gradually from green to violet as the camera moves rightward. The camera completes its arc and pushes forward into a new macro composition matching the final frame. The violet glow dominates the frame edges. Dark studio background. Sound: green frequency fades out, violet frequency fades in, ascending progression tones, soft glass chime at the end.
qc: Prompt contains ZERO content descriptions — only camera path, lighting color, depth of field, and sound
All content is carried entirely by the First Frame (F08) and Last Frame (F09) images
Green-to-violet lighting transition matches the engine color shift
Dark background throughout

segments.name: Grow to Value Metric
segments.prompt: Slow elegant forward push-in. The camera pushes through the current frame as all visible elements simultaneously dim to 20% opacity and defocus into abstract colored bokeh shapes. The camera continues forward through the dissolving bokeh into a clean centered composition. Depth of field narrows to razor-sharp macro focus at center frame with f/1.4 aperture. Accent lighting shifts from violet to neutral cyan glow. The camera settles into a perfectly static centered position above a polished reflective floor. Sound: deep sustained bass note, sweeping low-pass filter, then a premium glass chime.
qc: Prompt contains ZERO content descriptions — only camera, lighting, depth of field, and sound
All content carried entirely by First Frame (F09) and Last Frame (F10) images
Final composition is perfectly centered and static
Polished reflective floor visible

segments.name: Value Metric to Brand Resolution
segments.prompt: Slow graceful pull-back — the slowest camera motion in the entire video. The central number shrinks and fades as the camera retreats smoothly. A logo form with three curved organic prongs gradually materializes at center — the prongs are swept fluid arcs, NOT straight geometric lines, with NO handle or shaft below. Glass surfaces catch multi-colored rim lighting. Text appears below the logo. The camera settles into a perfectly centered static medium-wide composition above a polished reflective floor. The final 500 milliseconds are completely static — absolute confident stillness. Sound: deep sustained tone fading toward silence, gentle glass placement sound, then complete silence. CRITICAL: No classical trident shape, no straight prongs, no handle, no shaft at any intermediate frame.
qc: All intermediate logo frames show curved organic prongs — not classical trident
No handle, shaft, or stem artifact at any point
No straight prongs or arrow-tip shapes
Final mark matches F11
Last 500ms completely static

voiceover.delivery: Let the visual hook command attention

voiceover.text: Your finances live across five institutions. None of them talk to each other.
voiceover.delivery: Calm, factual. Slightly faster pace to match camera urgency

voiceover.text: Twelve and a half billion in fraud. Six billion in fees. A hundred thirty-three dollars a month — wasted.
voiceover.delivery: Deliberate emphasis on each number. Pause at the em-dash

voiceover.text: Data aggregation is solved. Coordination is not.
voiceover.delivery: Slower pace. Pause between sentences. 'Coordination is not' is the most authoritative line delivery

voiceover.text: Four engines — Protect, Grow, Execute, Govern — working as one.
voiceover.delivery: List the engines clearly. 'Working as one' lands with weight

voiceover.text: Every decision — explained. Every factor — visible. Every action — yours to approve.
voiceover.delivery: Tricolon rhetoric. Pause at each em-dash. The final clause emphasizes human-in-the-loop

voiceover.text: Your money grows when AI recommends and you decide.
voiceover.delivery: Warm, confident. Emphasizes the GROW→EXECUTE→human approval loop

voiceover.text: Four point three times the value returned. Seventeen and a half trillion dollars — waiting.
voiceover.delivery: Numbers spoken clearly. Pause at the em-dash. 'Waiting' lands as the kicker — implies massive untapped opportunity

voiceover.text: Poseidon. The trusted AI-native money platform.
voiceover.delivery: Slowest delivery. Pause after 'Poseidon.' Let the name land
